name: Sumo Supreme Megaways

features.name: Weight mechanic
features.description: Matching a reel's weight awards a special symbol.

features.name: Instant-pay symbols
features.description: Add value to wins they're part of.

review:
Japanese sumo wrestling on Megaways reels with tumbles – and one of Pragmatic's most original ideas. Instant-pay symbols add their value to any win they join.

Every symbol and reel gets a random weight. When the symbols on a reel weigh at least as much as the reel, a special symbol is awarded, and each cascade lowers the reel's weight by one, so specials get more likely as tumbles continue. 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
